mechanics.claim: The blade attack's bonus magic damage applies after the basic attack's primary damage and is not itself an on-hit effect (so it is not multiplied/blocked by on-hit interactions).
mechanics.quote: The blade attack bonus applies after the primary damage of the attack and is '''not''' an {{tip|on-hit}} effect.

mechanics.claim: The blade attack's bonus magic damage is increased the lower the target's current health is, up to double at 0 health, capping the scaling at 100% missing health.
mechanics.quote: increased by {{as|{{pp|0 to 100 by 5|0 to 100 by 5|formula=1% for every 1% missing health|key=%|key1=%|label1=target's '''missing''' health}}|health}}

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack against an immobilized target resets Samira's basic attack timer and is affected by critical strike modifiers, with each bolt rolling for crit separately.
mechanics.quote: resets '''Samira's''' basic attack timer, is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers, applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects only once, and cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.

mechanics.claim: Each bolt from the empowered attack rolls for a critical strike separately.
mechanics.quote: Each bolt from the empowered attack rolls for a {{tip|critical strike}} separately.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack's bolts deal basic damage for the first bolt (as a normal basic attack) and default damage for all subsequent bolts, which matters for damage amplification effects that check attack vs. spell damage.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Basic damage}} for the first bolt, as a basic attack would.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack applies lifesteal (a sustain source affecting the damage fight only insofar as it heals Samira, not relevant to damage dealt).
The empowered attack's bolt missile speed is unaffected by attack speed modifiers.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack's speed is unaffected by {{as|{{sti|attack speed}}}} modifiers.
